segments.he:
א.

עַל-יְדֵי טְבִילַת מִקְוֶה מַזְכִּירִין זְכוּת אָבוֹת.
segments.en: Through immersing in a ritual bath, one's ancestral merit is remembered.

segments.he:
א.

עַל-יְדֵי מֻפְלְגֵי וַחֲרִיפֵי הַדּוֹר מְאִירִין אֶת הַיִּרְאָה, וְעַל-יְדֵי הַיִּרְאָה מִתְנוֹצֵץ זְכוּת אָבוֹת, וְעַל-יְדֵי הִתְנוֹצְצוּת הָאָבוֹת נִתְעוֹרֵר תְּשׁוּבָה בָּעוֹלָם.
segments.en: At the entrance to a man's house it is discernible if his ancestral merit has finished, or if his ancestral merit is effective.

segments.he:
ב.

בְּפֶתַח בֵּיתוֹ שֶׁל אָדָם נִכָּר, אִם תַּמּוּ זְכוּת אֲבוֹתָיו אוֹ אִם חָלָה זְכוּת אֲבוֹתָיו.
segments.en: Brilliant, ingenious people of the generation inspire awe; through that awe, ancestral merit sparkles, and through the sparkling of ancestral merit, repentance is aroused in the world.

segments.he:
ג.

הַגּוֹמֵל חֲסָדִים, אֵין צָרִיךְ לִזְכוּת אָבוֹת.
segments.en:
At the entrance to a man's house it is discernible if his ancestral merit has finished, or if his ancestral merit is effective.

One who does acts of kindness does not need ancestral merit.
